summary.headline: Venus and Mercury’s Effects
summary.text: Astrological account of Venus and Mercury: their positions beneath the Sun’s and Venus’s zones, elemental qualities, relations to the Sun and Moon, and effects in sympathetic or unsympathetic zodiacal signs on air, sea, weather, fruits, earthquakes, and living creatures.
